name: Azores Current
source_citation: Carracedo, Gilcoto, Mercier and Perez (2014), Seasonal dynamics in the Azores-Gibraltar Strait region: A climatologically-based study, Progress in Oceanography 122, 116-130, doi:10.1016/j.pocean.2013.12.005.
source_access: Final original PDF: methods on PDF pages 3-4 and results on page 7 read; selected pages visually inspected. No original velocity field or figure curve digitized; no study reproduction.
source_locator: Section 3.1.1.1, printed page 122 / PDF page 7; methods section 2.1, printed page 118 / PDF page 3.
source_rights: Copyright Elsevier; original PDF and rendered page pixels excluded from Git. Attributed numerical source facts and an independently drawn comparison are packaged.
geographic_scope: Western WOA-Box section at 19.5 W. A regional cross-current model core extent, with no paired edge coordinates extracted.
boundary_rule: Author defines the core using velocities greater than 2 cm/s. No full-current envelope or universal half-peak threshold inferred.
layer: Depth-varying inverse-model section. Source reports maximum core depth about 790 m in spring and 1100 m in autumn; these are source-reported vertical context, not fixed depth layers at which these widths were measured.

season_convention.basis: WOA09 quarter definitions, not meteorological month windows
season_convention.source_locator: World Ocean Atlas 2009 Volume 1, Introduction, printed page 1 / PDF page 13
season_convention.source_access: Original Introduction text read and page visually inspected.

remaining_gates: Integrate these two distinct model-core records into the width inventory, source index and native/WASM UI with frozen source bindings.
Retain the 2009 110 km hydrographic section as a different metric, period and vertical support.
Recover model fields and boundary details before paired-edge geometry or study reproduction.
No width uncertainty is reported; transport errors do not supply width errors.
Independent scientific admission and canonical release review.
